questions.text: I prefer tasks and situations that have clear, definite right and wrong answers.
I feel uncomfortable when I don't understand the reason why an event occurred in my life.
I like to have things settled and decided rather than leaving them open and uncertain.

high.label: High Need for Closure
high.description: Strong preference for structure, certainty, and clear-cut answers. May be less comfortable with ambiguous situations.
bias_implications: May prefer familiar solutions over novel ones

moderate.label: Moderate Need for Closure
moderate.description: Balanced approach to certainty and ambiguity, preferring some structure while remaining open to uncertainty.
bias_implications: Generally good balance of quick vs deliberate thinking
Some preference for structure but open to alternatives

low.label: Low Need for Closure
low.description: Comfortable with uncertainty and ambiguity, may actually prefer open-ended situations.
bias_implications: More likely to consider multiple perspectives
May delay decisions to gather more information

dimensions.structure_preference: Preference for clear rules and definite answers
dimensions.ambiguity_discomfort: Discomfort with uncertain or unclear situations
dimensions.decisiveness: Preference for making decisions quickly and sticking to them

instructions: Please indicate how much you agree or disagree with each statement. Think about how you generally feel about uncertainty and decision-making.
